mapper.sql: s.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND s.deleted=0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user u WHERE u.id=#{userId} AND u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND u.status='ACTIVE' AND u.deleted=0) AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND ur.user_id=#{userId} AND r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.role_scope='TENANT' AND r.status='ACTIVE' AND r.deleted=0 AND r.role_code IN ('MERCHANT_ADMIN','FINANCE_OPERATOR','WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR','CUSTOMER_SERVICE_OPERATOR')) OR ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND ur.user_id=#{userId} AND r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.role_code='MERCHANT_OPERATOR' AND r.role_scope='TENANT' AND r.status='ACTIVE' AND r.deleted=0) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_store_scope uss WHERE uss.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND uss.user_id=#{userId} AND uss.store_id=s.id AND uss.status='ACTIVE') ) )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM merchant_store WHERE id=#{storeId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0
SELECT FROM merchant_store s WHERE s.id=#{storeId} AND
SELECT FROM merchant_store WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND store_code=#{storeCode} AND deleted=0
SELECT FROM merchant_store WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND platform_code=#{platformCode} AND platform_account=#{platformAccount} AND deleted=0

SELECT FROM merchant_store WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0 AND (#{status} IS NULL OR status=#{status}) AND (#{platformCode} IS NULL OR platform_code=#{platformCode}) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{offset},#{pageSize}

SELECT s.id,s.tenant_id,s.store_code,s.store_name,s.platform_code, (SELECT a.country_code FROM merchant_store_address a WHERE a.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND a.store_id=s.id AND a.status='ACTIVE' AND a.is_default=1 ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 1) country_region, (SELECT CONCAT(a.city,' / ',a.address_line1) FROM merchant_store_address a WHERE a.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND a.store_id=s.id AND a.status='ACTIVE' AND a.is_default=1 ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 1) default_shipping_address, (SELECT CONCAT(c.channel_code,' / ',c.channel_name) FROM merchant_store_channel sc JOIN logistics_channel c ON c.id=sc.channel_id WHERE sc.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND sc.store_id=s.id AND sc.status='ACTIVE' AND sc.is_default=1 ORDER BY sc.id DESC LIMIT 1) default_logistics_channel, s.status,s.version,s.updated_at FROM merchant_store s WHERE AND s.store_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{storeCode},'%') AND s.store_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{storeName},'%') AND s.platform_code=#{platformCode} AND s.status=#{status} ORDER BY s.store_codes.store_names.platform_codes.statuss.updated_ats.id ASCDESC,s.id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM merchant_store WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0 AND (#{status} IS NULL OR status=#{status}) AND (#{platformCode} IS NULL OR platform_code=#{platformCode})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipment_order WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND store_id=#{storeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE merchant_store SET store_name=#{storeName},platform_code=#{platformCode},platform_account=#{platformAccount},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{storeId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0 AND version=#{version}
UPDATE merchant_store SET status=#{status},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{storeId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0 AND version=#{version}
